titulo.alumno:
«Прямая цитата и пересказ»
Direct quotation and paraphrase

intro: A direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; a paraphrase summarises its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.

piezas.titulo: A direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; a paraphrase summarises its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.
texto: A direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; a paraphrase summarises its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.
Quotation marks, reporting verbs and references should let the reader distinguish the source's position from the writer's.

frases.alumno: The director stated: «The new building will open in autumn».

frases.estudio: Позже пресс-служба сообщила, что сроки пока не изменились.
frases.alumno: Later, the press office said that the dates had not changed yet.

opciones.explicacion: The quotation marks present the statement as a direct quotation.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Директор заявил: «Новый корпус откроется осенью».»

opciones.texto: The director stated: «The new building will open in autumn».
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: Later, the press office said that the dates had not changed yet.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Позже пресс-служба сообщила, что сроки пока не изменились

piezas.traduccion: Later, the press office said that the dates had not changed yet.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
